note: views_rss is the plugin-machinery-only parent: style plugin id rss_fields and row plugin id views_rss_fields (from src/Plugin/views/style/RssFields.php and src/Plugin/views/row/RssFields.php), each requiring the other, with per-View config at display.<id>.display_options.style.options.channel.<namespace>.<module>.<element> (channel) and ...row.options.item.<namespace>.<module>.<element> (item). All actual RSS elements come from the 5 submodules via hook_views_rss_namespaces()/hook_views_rss_channel_elements()/hook_views_rss_item_elements(). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real Views config entities (vrss_p_* machine names) built directly via the View entity API, mirroring what the style/row options forms would save.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module views_rss (Advanced Views RSS Feed) replaces core's RSS style for a Views Feed display. What are the exact plugin ids of its style plugin and its row plugin, and what do they require of each other?
evals.expected_output: The style plugin id is rss_fields ("Advanced RSS feed") and the row plugin id is views_rss_fields (also "Advanced RSS feed"). Each plugin's validate() requires the other to be in use on the same Feed display, and the row plugin additionally requires the views_rss_core submodule to be enabled.

evals.prompt: Which hooks does the views_rss module invite other modules to implement in order to add RSS <channel>/<item> elements and XML namespaces to a feed built with its style/row plugins?
evals.expected_output: hook_views_rss_namespaces(), hook_views_rss_channel_elements(), and hook_views_rss_item_elements() (plus _alter() variants of each, and hook_views_rss_date_sources()). views_rss_get() in views_rss.module invokes these on every implementing module and caches the merged result in the 'data' cache bin.

evals.prompt: views_rss installs a custom date format for RSS output. What is its machine name/pattern, and what PHP mechanism does the module use to format a timestamp with it?
evals.expected_output: It installs core.date_format.rfc822 with pattern 'D, d M y H:i:s O'. views_rss_format_date($timestamp) formats a UNIX timestamp using PHP's \DateTimeInterface::RFC822 constant via date().

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a View called vrss_p_desc with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed style plugin. Inspect its live configuration and report the configured text of the channel <description> element.
evals.expected_output: Views RSS QA marker: kiwi-9182 - found at views.view.vrss_p_desc: display.feed_1.display_options.style.options.channel.core.views_rss_core.description.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a View called vrss_p_item with an RSS feed display already configured using the Advanced Views RSS Feed row plugin, mapping some View field to the item <title> RSS element. Inspect its live configuration and report which field id is mapped to the item title element.

On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_p_task, base table Content (node), with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed style plugin (rss_fields) and row plugin (views_rss_fields), mapping the item <title> RSS element to the node's title field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_p_task has a display whose display_options.style.type is rss_fields, display_options.row.type is views_rss_fields, and display_options.row.options.item.core.views_rss_core.title is set to a non-empty field id (e.g. 'title').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, build a new View called vrss_p_links with a Feed display using the Advanced Views RSS Feed style plugin (rss_fields), and enable the 'Display feed icon in the links attached to the view' option in the style plugin's Other feed settings. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vrss_p_links has a display whose display_options.style.type is rss_fields and display_options.style.options.feed_settings.feed_in_links is truthy (1/true).
